messages.description: Installed plugin details, Permissions & Programs tab: the help behind the programs heading, saying why changing a setting needs no new review

en-US.desktop.marketplace.programsSettingsHelp: Setting values only fill the places the program templates reserve for them, so changing a setting never changes the programs listed here and needs no new review.

zh-CN.desktop.marketplace.programsSettingsHelp: 设置值只会填入程序模板预留的位置，不会改变这里列出的程序，所以修改设置不需要重新审查。
